[USER] User is looking for new recipe ideas that incorporate fresh herbs from their garden, especially rosemary and thyme.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggests several recipes featuring rosemary:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Rosemary Garlic Roasted Chicken: Mix minced rosemary, garlic, salt, and pepper, and rub it all over a whole chicken. Roast in the oven until crispy and golden.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Rosemary and Lemon Spaghetti: Toss cooked spaghetti with olive oil, minced rosemary, lemon zest, garlic, and grated Parmesan cheese.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Rosemary and Potato Gratin: Thinly slice potatoes and layer them in a baking dish with rosemary sprigs, cheese, and cream. Bake until golden and bubbly.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Rosemary and Garlic Focaccia: Mix minced rosemary and garlic into your favorite focaccia dough. Brush with olive oil and bake until crispy.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Rosemary Tea: Steep fresh rosemary leaves in hot water to create a soothing, caffeine-free tea.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggests several recipes featuring thyme:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Thyme and Lemon Soup: Simmer chicken or vegetable broth with thyme, lemon juice, and garlic. Blend until smooth and creamy.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Thyme and Mushroom Risotto: Sauté Arborio rice with thyme, mushrooms, and white wine. Finish with grated Parmesan cheese.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Thyme and Honey Glazed Pork Chops: Mix thyme, honey, Dijon mustard, and olive oil to create a sticky glaze for pork chops. Grill or pan-fry until caramelized.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Thyme and Spinach Stuffed Chicken Breasts: Mix sautéed spinach, thyme, garlic, and feta cheese. Stuff into chicken breasts and bake until cooked through.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Thyme and Lemon Hummus: Add fresh thyme leaves to your favorite hummus recipe for a refreshing twist.
